question.problem:
Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Let the joint CDF of $X$ and $Y$ be $F(x,y),$ where

$$
F(10,9)=0.55,\,F(10,3)=0.15,\,F(4,9)=0.1,\,F(4,3)=0.05,
$$

and the supports of $X$ and $Y$, respectively, are

$$
{S}_{X}=\{2,4,6,8,10,12\},\,{S}_{Y}=\{3,6,9,12\}.
$$

Find $P(5<X<11,4<Y<10).$
question.worked_solution:
Note the following:

- For a given joint PMF $f(x,y),$ we can think of each point where $f(x,y)\ne 0$ as a point mass in the plane, where the "probability mass" at each point equals the probability associated with that point.

- The joint CDF $F(x,y)=P(X\le x,Y\le y)$ is the total "probability mass" that lies in the infinite rectangular region that has its top-right corner at $(x,y)$ and whose sides are parallel to the coordinate axis.

Given the supports of $X$ and $Y,$ the joint support $S$ is a subset of

$$
{S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y}=\{2,4,6,8,10,12\}\times \{3,6,9,12\}.
$$

Let's plot the points in ${S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y},$ which contains the joint support, and sketch the region corresponding to the probability we wish to find.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14157784/assets/f43c5ae8d27872c4aebe235c507600b7bf1806e22b52dd3b3ff2261509ac9925.png)

Notice that this region encompasses the same possible support points as the rectangular region with its top-right corner at $(10,9)$ and bottom-left corner at $(4,3)$ below, where the top and right boundaries are inclusive and the bottom and left boundaries are exclusive.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14157784/assets/60bf5a958b682d513010c3eff9a8084072be62e286c0b0dfacb09960a3283e38.png)

Geometrically, this region can be obtained as follows:

1\. Take the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(10,9).$

2\. Subtract the infinite rectangles that have their top-right corners at $(10,3)$ and $(4,9).$

3\. Finally, we need to add back the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(4,3).$ This is because we subtracted this region twice in step 2.

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(5<X<11,4<Y<10) & =\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(10,9)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 10,Y\le 9)}} \\  & \,-\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(10,3)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 10,Y\le 3)}}-\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(4,9)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 4,Y\le 9)}} \\  & \,+\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(4,3)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 4,Y\le 3)}} \\  & =F(10,9)-F(10,3)-F(4,9)+F(4,3) \\  & =0.55-0.15-0.1+0.05 \\  & =0.35.\end{aligned}
$$
